games:2026-wk12-kentucky-missouri.blurb: No. 18 Kentucky heads to Columbia as a 5.5-point underdog with ESPN giving Missouri a 61.9% edge at home. With the total set at just 48.5, the Wildcats' ranking may hinge on whether they can grind out points on the road.

games:2026-wk12-lsu-tennessee.blurb: A true coin flip in Knoxville: Tennessee is laying only 1.5 and ESPN's model splits it 50.2-49.8 in LSU's favor. No. 9 Tennessee has far more to lose in the rankings, but No. 23 LSU can swing the SEC picture with a win.

games:2026-wk12-ohio-state-nebraska.blurb: No. 17 Ohio State is a 3.5-point favorite in Lincoln with a 71.3% win probability, but the 43.5 total says this one gets ugly and physical. Nebraska at home is exactly the kind of November trip that trims a Big Ten team's margin for error.

games:2026-wk12-ucla-michigan.blurb: No. 4 UCLA is favored by a touchdown at Michigan, yet ESPN sees it nearly even at 53.1-46.9 -- a sign of how much the Big House matters here. With a 39.5 total, the Bruins' playoff positioning could come down to a handful of possessions.

games:2026-wk12-byu-kansas.blurb: No. 12 BYU travels to Kansas as a 6.5-point favorite with ESPN giving the Cougars a 71% chance. BYU is sitting on the playoff bubble, so style points in Lawrence are worth more than usual.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-iowa-illinois.blurb: No. 13 Iowa is a 6-point favorite at Illinois with a 65.3% win probability and a 42.5 total that screams Hawkeye football. Iowa is just outside the playoff field, so a road win here is the kind that sticks.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-texas-tech-bay.blurb: No. 11 Texas Tech is a field-goal favorite in Waco with ESPN leaning Red Raiders at 61.4%. The 58.5 total points to a shootout, and Tech is chasing Utah in the Big 12 race.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-indiana-washin.blurb: No. 5 Indiana is an 8.5-point favorite in Seattle and ESPN gives the Hoosiers a 78.6% shot. A low 41.5 total means Indiana's Big Ten chase could hinge on winning a defensive slugfest on the road.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-oregon-michiga.blurb: No. 14 Oregon is a 13.5-point favorite at Michigan State with an 86.4% win probability. The Ducks are hovering on the bubble, so a convincing road result matters beyond the W.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-smu-notre-dame.blurb: No. 3 Notre Dame hosts SMU as a 20.5-point favorite with a 93.4% win probability. The Irish are in resume-protection mode -- anything close would be the story.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-wofford-ole-mi.blurb: No. 16 Ole Miss welcomes FCS Wofford with ESPN giving the Rebels a 99.7% chance and no line on the board. A tune-up before the stretch run, with the Rebels trying to climb back into the playoff picture.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-maryland-usc.blurb: No. 19 USC lays 16.5 at home against Maryland with a 93.1% win probability and a 56.5 total. The Trojans should be able to pile up points and protect their spot in the rankings.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-chattanooga-al.blurb: No. 7 Alabama hosts FCS Chattanooga with no line posted. It's a get-right Saturday for the Tide as they chase Georgia in the SEC race.
